title: 第12章 你只是穿着军装，他才是兵
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 转眼三天匆匆而过，此时的天刚蒙蒙亮。三班门前走廊上，就挤满了叠被子的新兵。宿舍内位置太小，没法铺开所有人的被褥，于是便将走廊过道也给利用上了。这会儿，周凯东正背着手一个个的检查，发现有人睡眼惺忪迷迷糊糊的，提神醒脑的一脑瓜子就敲上去。陆阳在班长走到跟前时，没控制住的打了个哈欠，很不幸的也挨了一下。好在周凯东并未在他面前停留，而是来到了手忙脚乱的孔垄面前站立动。“这个烂怂被子教特么几天了，到现在叠不会？”“我当时是这么教的？被子是这么擀的？”孔垄抬头望了班长一眼，又很是尴尬的低下头。因为紧张，本就记不太清的步骤，在脑袋里变得更加混乱。周凯东实在看不下去，直接把他推到一边，蹲在被子前做演示。“得这么使劲，这么碾。你那么搞，搞到明天被子也成不了行！”“哦...”孔垄弯着身子，像个不会做题的小学生一样。时不时还无辜的朝着边上陆阳看两眼，挤出尴尬笑容。陆阳瞧见他这副老实巴交的模样，再配合上他这块头，那种违和感莫名的让人想笑。“压完以后是量，用手指比划，一叉，两叉......然后定在这个点。”“记住了，两个手掐住，然后这么一捋，再这么一翻，不就完事了吗？”“顺着线这么捋过去，再把角一抠，这特么有什么记不住的？过来弄！”周凯东把刚叠好的被子重新抖散，让孔垄过来重复一遍他先前的过程。这小子蹲到被子前，脑袋再度变成一片空白，只能求助的把目光投向边上陆阳，希望他能江湖救急。陆阳也是立即秒懂，赶紧把面前被子抖散，对折后按照原先周凯东的教学步骤，进行一步步拆解。包括用手指比划次数，还有如何找到定位点。孔垄就这么低着头，斜眼瞅着陆阳那边，强行抄作业。做一步，瞅一眼；做一步，再瞅一眼；但凡陆阳动作快进一点点，他都得忘。“你老瞅人家干什么？”“擦，怎么还偷看上了，这么点儿步骤记不住？”周凯东很快就发现了孔垄的小动作，两次提醒无果，干脆直接横挡在他和陆阳之间，强行阻断了视线。没了复制对象的孔垄脑袋再度恢复一团乱麻的状态，忘记下一个步骤的他，再次抬头无辜的看向班长。周凯东气愤的瞪着他：“看我干什么，我长得像被子？继续叠啊，这一面好了，翻过来再弄那一面！”“啊？”“让你翻过来，翻过来不会吗？”陆阳主动挪到另一侧，让他抄。但此时双方进度已经不同步，陆阳只能不断用手势提醒他下一步该怎么做。可陆阳是真没想到，这家伙的理解能力能够差到这种地步。只见孔垄双手抓着被子两边，像是摊煎饼似的一百八十度翻了个面。意识到步骤做错又赶紧补救，结果弄得一团糟，是驴头不对马嘴。周凯东单手捂着脸，已经都被他给气笑了。陆阳也尽力了，这些天他私底下也教了好几回，但愣是教不会。孔垄在内务整理这方面的天赋，仅次于张飞学绣花，属于忘的比学得快那种。周凯东喊了一嗓子：“都特么给我滚到走廊上来集合！”很快，不明所以的新兵们就来到走廊上集合站好。周凯东也不管走廊上是不是还有其他班新兵在叠被，直接开喷。“两天了，被子还特么叠的跟坨狗屎一样，我就想不通了，这比造飞机火箭还还难？”“尤其是你！”孔垄缩着脖子，原以为要挨喷。但班长手指最终却落在了丁腾飞面前。“我原以为孔垄的被子，已经是狗屎一坨，结果你叠的连特么狗屎都不如！”“人家至少还知道要把被子压薄了再叠，你是压都不带压的？”“两天，教了七八遍，一遍一遍给你们演示，你是压根就没带脑子，还是天生智力残缺？”丁腾飞被班长指着鼻子喷了一脸唾沫星子，可他好了伤疤忘了疼，非但不觉得有错反而还嘴硬反驳。“报告，我是来当兵的，不是来当家政的！”“都来好几天了也不发枪，格斗也不教，天天光是叠被子，我想不通这有什么好叠的！”“不需要你想通！”周凯东的嗓门更大了：“连床被子都叠不好，还想摸到枪，还想学格斗，你觉得你够资格吗？”丁腾飞倔脾气一下子就上来了：“报告班长，我觉得我够资格，因为我也穿着军装，我也是一个兵！”周凯东并没有因为他的嘴硬生气，反倒是有点儿看得起他了。至少，他大胆表达了自已的不满，对部队制度提出了质疑。并且，他主观意义上的，认为自已是一个兵。周凯东也没有废话，直接喊了一嗓子。“陆阳！”“到！”“蹲下！”陆阳后脚掌迅速后退半步，迅速下蹲。尽管动作并不算特别标准，但下意识的反应非常快。周凯东大声说： “现在，给我在最短时间内，叠一床军被！”“是！”从撵被，到定位，再到对着成型后的捏边扣缝。陆阳每一步扎实认真，甚至带着点雷厉风行的味道。尽管完成后的被子依旧有些鼓鼓囊囊，和班长最初演示的相差甚远，但在三班新兵里头绝对算得上鹤立鸡群。周凯东让人将丁腾飞叠的那床发面馒头从宿舍里抱出来，和陆阳的被子放在一起作对比。有了衬托和比较，丁腾飞那床被班长形容成“狗屎都不如”的被子，在这一刻显得格外生动形象。正如班长先前所说，就连孔垄都知道要先压被子，但这家伙却完全听不进去，所以他的被子叠一万次都无法成型。周凯东用手指戳着丁腾飞的胸口，一字一句的说：“看懂了吗？你，只是穿上军装；而他，才叫一个兵，才有兵的样子！”丁腾飞拳头捏紧，想要继续嘴硬，却根本找不到话来反驳。但他始终觉得，将精力在这些没有意义的事情上，纯属浪费时间！正巧这时，指导员何镇涛从楼梯口走来，瞧见这边跟集体罚站似的，于是便询问怎么回事？周凯东解释：“我让班上内务最好的，给其他人做演示怎么叠。”指导员低头看了一眼，原本他倒是不觉得陆阳那床军被有什么特别出彩地方。但奈何有了绿叶的衬托，即便才是个花骨朵，也显得十分好看。“这床被子，谁叠的？”“报告，是我。”陆阳做出回应。当瞧见是这个喜欢读书的小子，指导员立马露出笑容。“叠的不错，有模有样的，一看就是下过苦功夫的。”“那边上这床，谁叠的？”“报告......我。”丁腾飞的声音不再像先前嘴硬时那般洪亮，反倒有些难以启齿。指导员并没有批评他，而是嗯了一声。转头拍拍周凯东的肩膀，任重而道远的说。“教新兵，还是得多点儿耐心，别动不动就大喊大叫的。”“是！”丁腾飞眼角抽动，内心仿佛遭受到了暴击。明明指导员一个字都没批评，但造成的伤害远比直接批评一顿，大得多。指导员随即询问：“你们排，有没有学过画画的，帮我一块出个主题板报。我刚楼上问一圈了，一个都没有。”周凯东：“回头我问问其他班。”指导员嗯了一声，刚要走就听见一声报告。他扭过头看向陆阳，露出诧异目光：“怎么，你学过画画？”陆阳点头：“以前学过一点儿素描。”指导员笑的合不拢嘴，可算是让他找着帮手了：“好好好，你跟我走一趟。一排长，你们该干嘛干嘛，内务方面要抓抓牢。”看着指导员领着人离开，周凯东也是没想到，陆阳竟还有绘画特长？班上其他人则露出羡慕目光，又是被班长表扬，又是被指导员叫去帮忙做事。明明是一块儿入伍的，这才第几天呐，差距就出来了？尤其是作为老乡的丁腾飞，像是生吃柠檬似的，心里酸溜溜的.......
content_en: Three days passed by in a blink of an eye, and it was just dawn.The corridor in front of the third class door was crowded with recruits folding quilts.The space in the dormitory was too small to spread out everyone's bedding, so the corridors were also used.At this moment, Zhou Kaidong was checking one by one with his hands behind his back, and found someone who was sleepy and dazed, so he knocked on his head as soon as he was refreshed.When the squad leader walked up to him, Lu Yang yawned uncontrollably, and unfortunately, he also yawned.Fortunately, Zhou Kaidong did not stop in front of him, but came to stand in front of Kong Long, who was in a hurry."How many days have you been teaching me how to fold quilts? Isn't it good at folding now?" "Is this how I was taught at the time? Is this how quilts are made?" Kong Long looked up at the squad leader, then lowered his head in embarrassment.Because of the nervousness, the steps that I couldn't remember clearly became even more confusing in my head.Zhou Kaidong couldn't stand it anymore, so he pushed him aside and squatted in front of the quilt to give a demonstration."You have to work so hard and grind like this. If you do it like that, you won't be able to make a quilt tomorrow!" "Oh..." Kong Long bent over like a primary school student who couldn't solve the problem.From time to time, he would glance innocently at Lu Yang beside him and force out an awkward smile.When Lu Yang saw his honest and courteous appearance, coupled with his size, the sense of inconsistency made people laugh."After pressing it, measure it, use your fingers to make a sign, one fork, two forks...and then fix it at this point." "Remember, pinch it with two hands, then stroke it like this, and turn it over again. Isn't it done?" "Follow the line like this, and then pull out the corners. What the hell can't you remember? Come here and do it!" Zhou Kaidong shook the newly folded quilt again, and asked Kong Rong to come over and repeat his previous process.The boy squatted in front of the quilt, his head went blank again, and he could only look to Lu Yang for help, hoping that he could help him.Lu Yang also understood immediately and quickly shook the quilt in front of him, folded it in half, and disassembled it step by step according to the original teaching steps of Zhou Kaidong.Including the number of finger gestures and how to find the anchor point.Kong Long just lowered his head, glanced sideways at Lu Yang, and forcibly copied his homework.Take a step and take a look; take a step and take another look; whenever Lu Yang moves forward a little faster, he has to forget."Why are you always looking at me?" "Why are you still peeking at me? Can't you remember such a few steps?" Zhou Kaidong quickly noticed Kong Long's little moves. He reminded him twice to no avail, so he simply stood between him and Lu Yang, forcibly blocking the line of sight.Without the copy target, Kong Long's head returned to a messy state again. He forgot the next step and looked up innocently at the squad leader again.Zhou Kaidong glared at him angrily: "Look what I'm doing, I look like a quilt? Keep folding, this side is ready, turn it over and do the other side!" "Ah?" "I want you to turn it over, won't you?" Lu Yang took the initiative to move to the other side and let him copy it.But at this time, the progress of the two parties was no longer synchronized, and Lu Yang could only keep using gestures to remind him what to do next.But Lu Yang really didn't expect that this guy's understanding ability could be so poor.Kong Long was seen grabbing both sides of the quilt with both hands and turning it over 180 degrees like spreading a pancake.Realizing that the steps were wrong and quickly correcting them, the result was a mess, which was wrong.Zhou Kaidong covered his face with one hand and was already laughing angrily at him.Lu Yang also tried his best. He had taught him several times in private these days, but he couldn't teach it.Kong Long's talent in housekeeping was second only to Zhang Fei's ability to learn embroidery, and he was one who forgot faster than he learned.Zhou Kaidong shouted: "Get the hell out of here and gather in the corridor!" Soon, the new recruits who didn't know what they were doing came to the corridor to gather and stand.Zhou Kaidong didn't care if there were other recruits in the corridor making quilts, and just started spraying."It's been two days, and the quilt is still folded like dog shit. I just can't figure it out. Is this more difficult than building a plane and rocket?" "Especially you!" Kong Long shrank his neck, thinking he was going to be sprayed.But the monitor's finger finally landed in front of Ding Tengfei."I thought Kong Long's quilt was already a piece of shit, but it turned out that you couldn't even fold it like shit!" "At least they know how to make the quilt thin before folding it, but you don't even press it?" "In two days, I taught you seven or eight times, and onceI've demonstrated it to you over and over again, are you totally clueless, or are you born with an intellectual disability?" Ding Tengfei was pointed in the nose and sprayed with saliva, but the scar healed and he forgot about the pain. Instead of feeling wrong, he retorted harshly."Report, I'm here to be a soldier, not a housekeeper!" "I've been here for several days without firing a gun, and I'm not taught how to fight. I just fold quilts every day. I can't figure out what's so good about folding them!" "You don't need to think about it!" Zhou Kaidong's voice got louder: "I can't even fold the quilt well, and I still want to touch it.You still want to learn fighting after getting a gun, do you think you are qualified?" Ding Tengfei suddenly became stubborn: "Report to the squad leader, I think I am qualified because I am also wearing a military uniform and I am also a soldier!" Zhou Kaidong was not angry because of his harsh words, but he looked up to him a little.At least, he boldly expressed his dissatisfaction and questioned the military system.Moreover, he considers himself a soldier in a subjective sense.Zhou Kaidong didn't waste any time and shouted directly."Lu Yang!" "Here!" "Squat down!" Lu Yang quickly stepped back half a step on the back of his feet and quickly squatted down.Although the movements are not particularly standard, the subconscious reaction is very fast.Zhou Kaidong said loudly: "Now, fold a military quilt for me in the shortest time!" "Yes!" From pushing out the quilt, to positioning, and then to the pinched and buttoned seams after forming.Lu Yang's every step was solid and serious, even with a hint of resoluteness.Although the finished quilt is still a little bulging and far from what the squad leader originally demonstrated, it is definitely outstanding among the recruits in the third squad.Zhou Kaidong had someone take the bed of steamed buns that Ding Tengfei had folded out of the dormitory and put them together with Lu Yang's quilt for comparison.With the background and comparison, Ding Tengfei's quilt, which the squad leader described as "worse than shit", seemed particularly vivid at this moment.As the squad leader said before, even Kong Long knew that he had to press the quilt first, but this guy couldn't listen at all, so his quilt couldn't take shape even after being folded ten thousand times.Zhou Kaidong poked Ding Tengfei's chest with his finger and said word for word: "Do you understand? You just put on a military uniform; but he is called a soldier and looks like a soldier!" Ding Tengfei clenched his fists and wanted to continue to be tough, but he couldn't find the words to refute.But he always felt that focusing on these meaningless things was a waste of time!It happened that at this time, the instructor He Zhentao came from the stairs and saw what looked like a collective punishment stand here, so he asked what was going on?Zhou Kaidong explained: "I asked the best housekeeper in the class to demonstrate to the others how to fold it." The instructor lowered his head and glanced at it. Originally, he didn't think there was anything particularly outstanding about Lu Yang's quilt.But with the background of green leaves, even a flower flower looks very beautiful."Who folded this quilt?" "It's me who reported it." Lu Yang responded.When he saw this boy who loved reading, the instructor immediately smiled."It's a good folding job. It has a decent look. You can tell it's been hard work." "Who folded this bed over there?" "Report...me." Ding Tengfei's voice was no longer as loud as when he spoke harshly before, but was rather difficult to say.The instructor did not criticize him, but just nodded.He turned around and patted Zhou Kaidong on the shoulder, and said he had a long way to go."Teach the new recruits to be more patient and not to shout at every turn." "Yes!" Ding Tengfei's eyes twitched, as if he had been hit hard in his heart.Obviously the instructor didn't criticize a word, but the damage caused was far greater than a direct criticism.The instructor immediately asked: "Do you have any people in your platoon who have learned drawing? Help me make a theme poster. I just asked around upstairs, and there was no one." Zhou Kaidong: "I'll ask other classes later." The instructor hummed, and just as he was about to leave, he heard a report.He turned his head and looked at Lu Yang with a surprised look: "What, you have learned painting?" Lu Yang nodded: "I have learned a little bit of sketching before." The instructor smiled from ear to ear, but he asked him to find a helper: "Okay, okay, you come with me. Platoon leader, what are you doing? Keep a close eye on internal affairs." Watching the instructor leading people away, Zhou Kaidong also didn't expect that Lu Yang actually had a talent for painting?Others in the class looked enviously, being praised by the monitor and called by the instructor to help.We obviously joined the army together, but it's only been a few days, and the gap has already emerged?Especially Ding Tengfei, a fellow countryman, felt as if he was eating a lemon raw, feeling sour in his heart...
